task:
Open the file /home/user/Documents/reference_guide.odt in LibreOffice Writer. The document contains a reference guide with sections but no headings, no page layout changes, and all paragraphs in Default Paragraph Style.

Perform the following formatting and layout tasks:

1. Change the page orientation to Landscape (Format > Page Style > Page tab, set Orientation to Landscape).
2. Set the first paragraph 'API Reference Guide' to Heading 1 style and make it bold.
3. Set the following paragraphs to Heading 2 style: 'Authentication', 'Endpoints', 'Error Codes', and 'Rate Limits'.
4. Add a page header with the text 'API Reference v2.0' (Format > Page Style > Header tab, enable header, then type the text).
5. Add a page footer with the text 'Internal Use Only' (Format > Page Style > Footer tab, enable footer, then type the text).
6. Save the file (Ctrl+S).
